propositions: Inner-workflow sidecar metrics.total_ms for plan-review is approximately 4-7 minutes at p50-p90 (189-325s), but visible end-to-end command wall time is 7-16 minutes due to pre-workflow setup and post-workflow duplicate/overlap detection and signing.

Completion-verifier inner-workflow duration is approximately 2-3 minutes at p50-p90 (87-156s), but end-to-end gated-close command wall time is 10-45 minutes due to pre-workflow referencing-commit scans on high-commit-count repos.

Current-regime (post 2026-08-22) plan-review end-to-end duration averages 15-22 minutes and close duration averages 35-70 minutes, representing performance degradation from earlier-window medians; pre-workflow commit scans are the dominant current latency driver.

Provider-clean cohorts (bedrock: ran_model filter) are large and stable (plan n=1,514, completion n=683 sidecar; plan n=78, close n=38 end-to-end) with p99 latencies of 7-42 minutes sidecar and 42-61 minutes end-to-end, indicating real performance tails unrelated to malformed records.

Observed bug grassy-cracked-morpho: close_precheck._check_work_landed performs 3.8 million ticket-directory visits via commit_impact.referencing_commits and _scan_alias for impact-present closes, explaining the 10-45 minute end-to-end latency.

rebar metrics exposes no operation-duration or percentile metrics; independent sidecar and session-log extraction was required; documented matched-log sensitivity shows 282 plan-review end-to-end samples and confirms core plus post-sidecar tail is 6.6-9.8 minutes.
